tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page, the app window, menus, sheets and dialogs. A cool off-white leaning toward the ink; in dark, a night navy near black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: One tone step off the ground: model cards, the sentence being played, a sheet's header, About's mascot stage, the site's footer, tiles and one band of sections. Areas are told apart by this step, not by lines.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Two steps off the ground: buttons at rest, the Find field, the switch's track, empty progress tracks, key caps, a Details box, a menu's ring and dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and figures on ground, surface and sunk (12:1 or more in both themes); the site's Download buttons; a chosen card's 2 px ring. Night navy, never black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, sizes, status lines, descriptions, credits, unselected labels, legal text; a paused progress bar. On ground, surface and sunk (5.7:1 or more). Never the transcript itself.

tokens.name: plume
tokens.usage: The accent, a sky-blue budgie's plumage: the primary button, the site's stage, the played part of a waveform, progress in dark, search ticks and highlights. Never text on the ground.

tokens.name: plume-press
tokens.usage: The drop overlay's fill while files are dragged over the window.

tokens.name: on-plume
tokens.usage: Text, icons and the dashed edge on plume and plume-press, in both themes (7.5:1 or more). Never white.

tokens.name: beak
tokens.usage: A mark: the wordmark's square, the playhead, the square after the playing row's time, the playing word's underline. Never text. One area, and only one: the speaker's button while playback is muted or at 0, filled as a warning whose undoing is the next click, its icon in term on it (4.02:1 light, 7.59 dark; Peter, 2026-10-27). Never another area (3.9:1 on light ground, 8.6:1 on dark).

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: The dark field in both themes: the waveform strip, the toast, and one dark band of sections on the site. On the dark theme a step above the ground, 1.13:1, so that the strip's edge shows: below it, at 1.04:1, the strip all but vanished into the page.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Text on term (14:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on term: the times, the stats line (6.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: A quiet fill on term: the play button, a speed changed from 1x, and the bars of a strip still empty; the empty track of a bar on the site's dark band. 1.51:1 against term on the light theme and 1.54:1 on the dark.

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: Unplayed waveform bars on term (3.5:1); progress fill on the light theme, where plume is 1.5:1 against the track.

tokens.name: wave-played
tokens.usage: Waveform bars behind the playhead. An alias of plume.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, Downloaded: always beside its word. On ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: A failure, always beside its reason; the word on the one destructive button. On ground, surface and sunk.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Hover over any control, laid over its fill or what it sits on: darkens in light, lightens in dark.

tokens.name: tint-press
tokens.usage: Press, the same way.

tokens.name: tint-term
tokens.usage: Hover on term and on an ink fill.

tokens.name: tint-term-press
tokens.usage: Press on term and on an ink fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or the ask dialog, over the screen it covers.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid, 2px offset in the app, 3px on the site. Ink in light, plume in dark; plume on term in both.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text: ink, underlined 1px at 0.2em; 2px on hover.

families.mono: "Commit Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The one number a screen is about: the model download's percentage in the app. Tabular figures. Not used on the site.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero h1 and a split heading on the site. clamp(52px, 5.2vw, 80px); 10vw on a phone. Two lines at most, sentence case. Not used in the app.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Section headings on the site; a screen's heading and the drop overlay's line in the app. 22px on a phone.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: pktito transcribes audio and video on your computer, and nothing is uploaded.
styles.usage: Running text on the site, 45–75 characters a line. 17px on a phone.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: So the plan is to ship the desktop build first and keep the library small enough to read in a weekend.
styles.usage: The transcript in the app. Looser leading than body, for reading at length.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The first paragraph of an intro and inline emphasis. Never bold 700 in running text.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: App buttons, file names, menu items. The app's working size.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Status lines, nav links on the site, legal text, credits. Running text goes no smaller; secondary detail may go to 12px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and terminal output. Commit Mono only sets real code, commands, output, file names, flags and timestamps.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Timestamps beside a transcript's rows, lengths in a row, the strip's time. hh:mm:ss, hh:mm:ss.cc, or SMPTE frames when chosen. Tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; inside a menu.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a row and a menu item; time to sentence.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between a screen's parts; padding inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between grid columns on the site; a heading to its text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The hero's padding; a section's padding on a phone.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between and inside sections on the site.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The footer's distance from the last section.

tokens.name: margin-page
tokens.usage: The site's outer margins at desktop; 20px on a phone (16px plus the safe-area inset at least).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything on the site: buttons, bands, tiles, the stage.

tokens.name: radius-ui
tokens.usage: App controls and containers: buttons, cards, the strip, menus, sheets, the toast. As macOS and Windows 11 round their own.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Items inside a container: switch segments, menu items, rate chips, the row's remove button.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Progress tracks and the spinner.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only what floats: menus, sheets, the ask dialog, the toast. Nothing at rest.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Width of running text, about 65 characters of body.

tokens.name: column-narrow
tokens.usage: The transcript's widest column in the app.

tokens.name: window-min
tokens.usage: The app window's minimum, each way (tauri.conf.json); it opens at 680 by 800.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest the site's grid gets; full-bleed fields still run to the viewport edge.
